articles.title: Iberdrola Raises Generation Capacity to Nearly 59GW
articles.summary: The Spanish company's U.S. portfolio saw the biggest growth (+693MW), while battery energy storage led growth by technology across Iberdrola's global portfolio.

articles.title: Iberdrola acquires Italian solar plant
articles.summary: Iberdrola has reached an agreement to acquire a solar photovoltaic plant located in Italy with an installed capacity of 42 MW from CCE.

articles.title: Vineyard Wind sues GE Vernova over $4.5bn offshore wind project
articles.summary: The offshore wind farm’s future is uncertain as Vineyard Wind and GE Vernova dispute contract terms and outstanding payments.

articles.title: Iberdrola to secure 98% stake in Brazilian arm Neoenergia
